maintainability low L21-L25
The doc comment claims an invariant that this module does not actually enforce: `case_passed == case_total` is only true at the `runner.rs` call site (`compute(cases.len(), cases.len(), …)`), not inside `metrics::compute`. Inside `compute`, `case_passed` is just passed through from the caller and the `task_success_rate` is computed from it normally. The placeholder flag is therefore decoupled from the actual `case_passed`/`case_total` relationship — a future caller could pass `case_passed=5, case_total=10` and still get `case_passed_placeholder: true`. Either move the "100% 占位" invariant documentation to the caller side, or have `compute` itself set the flag based on a clearly-stated precondition (e.g., expose a separate `compute_placeholder(...)` entry point).

maintainability high L44-L80
The `corrupt_backed_up` flag is local to each `read_jsonl` invocation, and the read path is hot — `read_all` is called by panel commands (every panel load), `apply.rs:262`/`506` (every auto-apply), `observe/shadow.rs:375` (every shadow observation), and `eval/runner.rs:35`. With persistent corruption, every call produces a brand-new `<name>.corrupt-<ts>` copy, so disk usage grows unbounded and the forensic intent collapses (100 identical copies of the same broken file isn't 100× more forensically useful than 1). Consider deduping by (a) checking whether a recent backup exists and only copying when none does, or (b) recording the last-corruption timestamp in a sidecar and skipping if one was made within a reasonable window. The current docstring says "B4-3：首个坏行触发一次整体备份……后续坏行同文件不重复备份" — this should be cross-call, not just intra-call, to match the forensic intent.

performance medium L42-L45
`std::fs::copy` here is called while `reader` (a `BufReader` over the same file) is still live and may have prefetched bytes ahead of the corruption point. If the JSONL is being concurrently appended (e.g., shadow hooks appending `ProposalEntry` while the panel reads `read_all` — note `write_proposals` does read_all→dedup→append on the same file under the evolution store lock, but readers outside that lock aren't synchronized with writers), the backup snapshot can reflect a state that diverges from what the loop actually saw, which weakens the forensic value the docstring promises. Consider taking the backup before opening the read handle, or under the same `EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK` that serializes `write_proposals` vs the panel-side `read_all`, so the captured state is the one whose read ended.

performance medium L53-L65
Confirmed #1 is the root concern, but worth pinning the cost here: `std::fs::copy` reads + writes the entire file synchronously on the read path. `read_jsonl` is called from `panel/commands.rs:36/40` (every panel open / list / refresh), `apply.rs:262/506` (every auto-apply), `observe/shadow.rs:375` (every shadow observation), and `eval/runner.rs:35`. For a proposals.jsonl that's grown to MB-range over time, this turns every panel load into an O(file-size) full copy as long as one bad byte persists — which, since the corrupt file isn't truncated or quarantined, is essentially forever. Either quarantine the bad lines (rewrite file without them) so the next read returns cleanly, or cap backup creation rate (e.g. write a `.corrupt-done` marker next to the jsonl and skip future copies) so the cost is paid once per corruption episode rather than once per read.

test high L189-L199
`resolve_applied_path()` is the central fix for P2-EV8 (a bug where the wrong path was being read), yet it has zero unit-test coverage. Given the function has three priority branches and was introduced specifically to prevent the previous regression, each branch deserves a test: - priority 1: explicit `--applied` override wins regardless of `db_path` / `eval_set_path` - priority 2: `db_path.parent()` + `evolution-applied.jsonl` is chosen when no override - priority 3: `eval_set_path_with_applied()` fallback only fires when both `applied_override` and `db_path` are `None` - edge: bare `db_path` (e.g. `"foo.db"` → `parent() == Some("")`) — currently falls through to CWD, document/cover this. Without these, future refactors could re-introduce the same bug.
Existing Code

1|//! EvalRunner —— 跑一轮评估、产出 MetricsReport
2|//!
3|//! 流程：
4|//!   1. 加载 eval_set.jsonl → EvalCase 列表
5|//!   2. 加载 evolution-applied.jsonl → AppliedRecord 列表
6|//!   3. 打开 dev DB（rusqlite 直连，无 AppHandle）→ 列出当前存活 lesson 的 mem_key
7|//!   4. 加载 feedback.jsonl → 计算 tool_calls_total / succeeded / hit_fractions
8|//!   5. compute() → MetricsReport
9|//!   6. 追加写 evolution-eval-results.jsonl + 打印到 stdout
10|//!
11|//! 不调 LLM；不动 prompt / TOOLS / 命令名 / 事件名 / JSON 字段 / 错误码。

22|/// 跑一轮评估，返回 MetricsReport
23|///
24|/// `period` 标签："manual" / "before" / "after" / 自定义
25|/// `db_path`：dev SQLite 文件路径（None 时跳过 mem_items 状态读取，回滚率/存活期=0）
26|/// `applied_path`：B4-1 覆盖（CLI `--applied`）；None 按优先级推导
27|///（db 同目录 > eval_set 同目录兜底）
28|pub fn run(
29|    cfg: &EvolutionEvalConfig,
30|    db_path: Option<&Path>,
31|    applied_path: Option<&Path>,
32|    period: &str,
33|) -> Result<MetricsReport, String> {
34|    // 1. eval set
35|    let cases: Vec<EvalCase> = read_jsonl(&cfg.eval_set_path)?;
36|    // 2. applied（B4-1：路径推导修正）
37|    let applied_path = resolve_applied_path(cfg, db_path, applied_path);
38|    let applied = read_applied(&applied_path)?;
39|    // 3. live keys
40|    let live_keys: Vec<String> = if let Some(p) = db_path {
41|        list_live_lesson_keys(p)?
42|    } else {
43|        Vec::new()
44|    };
45|    // 4. feedback
46|    let feedback = read_feedback(&cfg.feedback_path)?;
47|    let (tool_total, tool_ok, hit_fractions) = aggregate_feedback(&cases, &feedback);
48|    // 5. compute
49|    let now_ms = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis();
50|    let report = compute(
51|        cases.len(),
52|        cases.len(), // B4-1 标注：无 case 级判定，恒 100% 占位（MetricsReport.case_passed_placeholder=true）；R2 接入 ChangeRecord 后实判
53|        tool_total,
54|        tool_ok,
55|        &applied,
56|        &live_keys,
57|        &hit_fractions,
58|        now_ms,
59|        period,
60|    );
61|    Ok(report)
62|}

64|/// 把 eval 结果追加到 evolution-eval-results.jsonl
65|pub fn append_result(path: &Path, report: &MetricsReport) -> Result<(), String> {
66|    use std::io::Write;
67|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
68|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
69|    }
70|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
71|        .create(true)
72|        .append(true)
73|        .open(path)
74|        .map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
75|    let line =
76|        serde_json::to_string(report).map_err(|e| format!("序列化 MetricsReport 失败：{e}"))?;
77|    writeln!(f, "{line}").map_err(|e| format!("写入 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
78|    Ok(())

81|/// 列出当前 mem_items 里 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的 mem_key
82|///
83|/// 只读；缺表返回空 vec（dev DB 没建表时不 panic）
84|fn list_live_lesson_keys(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
85|    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 DB {db_path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
86|    let exists: i64 = conn
87|        .query_row(
88|            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mem_items'",
89|            [],
90|            |r| r.get(0),
91|        )
92|        .map_err(|e| format!("查 mem_items 表失败：{e}"))?;
93|    if exists == 0 {
94|        return Ok(Vec::new());
95|    }
96|    let mut stmt = conn
97|        .prepare("SELECT tags FROM mem_items WHERE kind='lesson'")
98|        .map_err(|e| format!("prepare mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
99|    let rows = stmt
100|        .query_map([], |r| {
101|            let tags: String = r.get(0)?;
102|            Ok(tags)
103|        })
104|        .map_err(|e| format!("query mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
105|    let mut keys = Vec::new();
106|    for row in rows {
107|        let tags = row.map_err(|e| format!("read row 失败：{e}"))?;
108|        // tags 是逗号分隔；取第一段
109|        if let Some(first) = tags.split(',').next() {
110|            let first = first.trim();
111|            if first.starts_with("evo:") {
112|                keys.push(first.to_string());
113|            }
114|        }
115|    }
116|    Ok(keys)
117|}

119|/// 把 feedback 按 session / case 聚合
120|fn aggregate_feedback(
121|    cases: &[EvalCase],
122|    feedback: &[FeedbackEntry],
123|) -> (u64, u64, Vec<(String, f64)>) {
124|    // tool_calls: 全部 ToolError 信号视为失败调用，task_complete 视为成功调用
125|    let mut total: u64 = 0;
126|    let mut succeeded: u64 = 0;
127|    for f in feedback {
128|        match f.signal_type {
129|            SignalType::ToolError => {
130|                total += 1;
131|                // value 0.0/1.0 = 失败/不一定（按 0 算）
132|            }
133|            SignalType::TaskComplete => {
134|                total += 1;
135|                succeeded += 1;
136|            }
137|            SignalType::TaskFailed => {
138|                total += 1;
139|            }
140|            _ => {}
141|        }
142|    }
143|    // hit_fractions: 对每个 case 检查 feedback 里 thumbs_up / thumbs_down 比例
144|    let mut hit_fractions: Vec<(String, f64)> = Vec::new();
145|    for c in cases {
146|        let related: Vec<&FeedbackEntry> = feedback
147|            .iter()
148|            .filter(|f| {
149|                f.case_id.as_deref() == Some(c.case_id.as_str()) || f.session_id == c.case_id
150|            })
151|            .collect();
152|        if related.is_empty() {
153|            hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), 1.0));
154|            continue;
155|        }
156|        let pos = related
157|            .iter()
158|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsUp))
159|            .count() as f64;
160|        let neg = related
161|            .iter()
162|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsDown))
163|            .count() as f64;
164|        let frac = if pos + neg > 0.0 {
165|            pos / (pos + neg)
166|        } else {
167|            1.0
168|        };
169|        hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), frac));
170|    }
171|    (total, succeeded, hit_fractions)
172|}

174|// EvolutionEvalConfig 扩展：applied 路径兜底推导。B4-1（P2-EV8）：真实路径
175|// 优先级 = 显式 --applied > db_path 同目录（applied.jsonl 与 DB 同在 data_dir）
176|// > 此兜底；此前直接用本兜底会读到 `<eval_set>.applied.jsonl`（不存在 → 空
177|// applied → 回滚率/污染存活期恒 0）
178|trait ConfigExt {
179|    fn eval_set_path_with_applied(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf;
180|}
181|impl ConfigExt for EvolutionEvalConfig {
182|    fn eval_set_path_with_applied(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf {
183|        let mut p = self.eval_set_path.clone();
184|        p.set_extension("applied.jsonl");
185|        p
186|    }
187|}

189|/// B4-1：applied.jsonl 路径解析（--applied 覆盖 > db 同目录 > 兜底）
190|pub(crate) fn resolve_applied_path(
191|    cfg: &EvolutionEvalConfig,
192|    db_path: Option<&Path>,
193|    applied_override: Option<&Path>,
194|) -> std::path::PathBuf {
195|    applied_override
196|        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
197|        .or_else(|| db_path.and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("evolution-applied.jsonl"))))
198|        .unwrap_or_else(|| cfg.eval_set_path_with_applied())
199|}

153|/// 采样决策（纯函数，可单测）：
154|/// 只在以下条件之一成立时记录 trace：
155|/// 1. `outcome` 是 `Failure` 或 `Aborted`（用户 /stop 恒记录，不静默丢）
156|/// 2. 工具调用数 > 10（`tool_calls.len()`）
157|/// 3. `duration_ms > 60_000`（即 60s）
158|pub fn should_record_trace(
159|    outcome: &TraceOutcome,
160|    tool_calls_count: u32,
161|    duration_ms: i64,
162|) -> bool {
163|    if matches!(
164|        outcome,
165|        TraceOutcome::Failure { .. } | TraceOutcome::Aborted
166|    ) {
167|        return true;
168|    }
169|    if tool_calls_count > TOOL_CALLS_THRESHOLD {
170|        return true;
171|    }
172|    if duration_ms > DURATION_THRESHOLD_MS {
173|        return true;
174|    }
175|    false
176|}
177|
178|/// 上报 trace（如采样命中）。同步，< 1ms（仅 KV 拼装 + 一次 audit_event!）。

183|pub fn maybe_record_trace(ctx: TraceContext<'_>) {

Since both consume fields by move, the order is: 1. Move `loop_trace.turn_count` (u32, copy) 2. Move `loop_trace.tool_calls` (Vec, move) This works fine because `u32` is `Copy`. But if `LoopTrace` had any non-Copy fields that were read after a move, we'd have an issue. Let me re-verify by looking at the `LoopTrace` struct: ```rust pub struct LoopTrace { pub turn_count: u32, pub tool_calls: Vec<crate::evolution::trace::ToolCallSummary>, } ``` `u32` is `Copy`, `Vec` is not. The `task_refs` field defaults to empty Vec, `turn_count` defaults to 0, `tool_calls` defaults to empty Vec. 120|/// DSL 调度器 / PREVR / 幻觉守卫 / skill_on_step_post / 审计分级全部共用。
121|///
122|/// 「失败/错误」改为 markdown 前缀 + 关键词后接分隔符才判失败：
123|/// 1. markdown 前缀（#/-/*/数字列表）→ 过滤文档小标题「# 失败案例分析」
124|/// 2. 关键词后必须紧跟分隔符（：：，、、；； 空格 ()） → 过滤正文里裸出现的
125|///    「失败」「错误」（如「失败重试策略」），保留真错误消息「删除失败：权限不足」
126|/// 3. 首行 ≤120 **字符**（非字节，中文一字 3 字节，按字计算才一致；之前用 len()
127|///    实际只容 40 个汉字，过严误杀中文错误消息）
128|/// 4. 英文 error/Error/ERROR 都要带冒号（Error: 404 / ERROR: timeout），
129|///    避免「Error handling guide」这种标题被误判
130|pub fn tool_call_failed(name: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
131|    let _ = name;
132|    text.starts_with("未知工具")
133|        || text.starts_with("⚠️") // 门禁拦截（原子工具裸调等）
134|        || text.starts_with("用户拒绝") // 确认弹窗被拒绝/超时
135|        || text.starts_with("技能已暂停") // step_check 暂停态拒绝
136|        || text.contains("已强制终止") // step_check 步数/超时熔断
137|        || failure_keyword_after_separator(text)
138|        || text.starts_with("error:")
139|        || text.starts_with("Error:")
140|        || text.starts_with("ERROR:")
141|}
142|
143|/// 失败/错误关键词后置分隔符判定：仅在首行 ≤120 **字符**、markdown 前缀开头
144|/// 或无前缀、关键词后紧跟分隔符（：：，、；； 空格 ()）时判失败。
145|///
146|/// 分隔符集合是中英文常见标点 + 空格，覆盖绝大多数真错误消息
147|/// （「删除失败：权限不足」「运行失败, exit code 1」「生成失败 磁盘只读」
148|/// 「失败重试（最多3次）」）；不包含「的」「了」等普通连词，避免「失败的请求」
149|/// 这种语义中性文本被误判。
150|fn failure_keyword_after_separator(text: &str) -> bool {
151|    // 首行 + 字符数限制（120 字 = 120 chars，按字算中文友好）
152|    let Some(first) = text.lines().next().map(str::trim) else {
153|        return false;
154|    };
155|    if first.is_empty() || first.chars().count() > 120 {
156|        return false;
157|    }
158|    // markdown 前缀判定：# 标题 / - 项目符号 / * 项目符号 / 数字. 列表
159|    // 容许纯文本（无前缀）也通过——错误消息本身就不带 markdown 符号
160|    let body = strip_markdown_prefix(first);
161|    let body = body.trim_start();
162|    if body.is_empty() {
163|        return false;
164|    }
165|    // 关键词后置分隔符集合
166|    const SEPARATORS: &[char] = &['：', ':', '，', ',', '、', '；', ';', ' ', '（', '('];
167|    has_keyword_after(body, "失败", SEPARATORS) || has_keyword_after(body, "错误", SEPARATORS)
168|}

55|/// <think> 标签拆分：喂入流式文本，返回 (正文, 思考)。标签跨流式块时用 think_buf 缓冲。
56|fn feed_think(in_think: &mut bool, buf: &mut String, text: &str) -> (String, String) {
57|    const OPEN: &str = "<think>";
58|    const CLOSE: &str = "</think>";
59|    buf.push_str(text);
60|    let mut normal = String::new();
61|    let mut think = String::new();
62|    loop {
63|        if !*in_think {
64|            if let Some(pos) = buf.find(OPEN) {
65|                normal.push_str(&buf[..pos]);
66|                buf.drain(..pos + OPEN.len());
67|                *in_think = true;
68|            } else {
69|                // 结尾可能是不完整的 <think> 前缀，留着等下一块
70|                let keep = tail_prefix_len(buf, OPEN);
71|                if keep > 0 {
72|                    let cut = buf.len() - keep; // keep 为 ASCII 前缀，字节数=字符数
73|                    normal.push_str(&buf[..cut]);
74|                    buf.drain(..cut);
75|                } else {
76|                    normal.push_str(buf);
77|                    buf.clear();
78|                }
79|                break;
80|            }
81|        } else if let Some(pos) = buf.find(CLOSE) {
82|            think.push_str(&buf[..pos]);
83|            buf.drain(..pos + CLOSE.len());
84|            *in_think = false;
85|        } else {
86|            let keep = tail_prefix_len(buf, CLOSE);
87|            if keep > 0 {
88|                let cut = buf.len() - keep;
89|                think.push_str(&buf[..cut]);
90|                buf.drain(..cut);
91|            } else {
92|                think.push_str(buf);
93|                buf.clear();
94|            }
95|            break;
96|        }
97|    }
98|    (normal, think)
99|}

14|/// 审计日志安全转义 + 截断（bot 侧日志写入统一走这里）：
15|/// 剥换行/管道符，防伪造「INFO |」前缀与多行撕裂。
16|/// 规则：`| ` → `|  `（双空格），剩余裸 `|` → `||`，`\n` → `\\n`，`\r` → `\\r`；
17|/// 转义后按字符数截到 max 加省略号。
18|/// 例：`"a\nb| c"` → `"a\\nb||  c"`
19|pub(crate) fn escape_for_log(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
20|    let escaped = s
21|        .replace("| ", "|  ")
22|        .replace('|', "||")
23|        .replace('\n', "\\n")
24|        .replace('\r', "\\r");
25|    let count = escaped.chars().count();
26|    if count <= max {
27|        escaped
28|    } else {
29|        let mut out: String = escaped.chars().take(max).collect();
30|        out.push('…');
31|        out
32|    }
33|}

146|/// 分隔符集合是中英文常见标点 + 空格，覆盖绝大多数真错误消息
147|/// （「删除失败：权限不足」「运行失败, exit code 1」「生成失败 磁盘只读」
148|/// 「失败重试（最多3次）」）；不包含「的」「了」等普通连词，避免「失败的请求」
149|/// 这种语义中性文本被误判。
150|fn failure_keyword_after_separator(text: &str) -> bool {
151|    // 首行 + 字符数限制（120 字 = 120 chars，按字算中文友好）
152|    let Some(first) = text.lines().next().map(str::trim) else {
153|        return false;
154|    };
155|    if first.is_empty() || first.chars().count() > 120 {
156|        return false;
157|    }
158|    // markdown 前缀判定：# 标题 / - 项目符号 / * 项目符号 / 数字. 列表
159|    // 容许纯文本（无前缀）也通过——错误消息本身就不带 markdown 符号
160|    let body = strip_markdown_prefix(first);
161|    let body = body.trim_start();
162|    if body.is_empty() {
163|        return false;
164|    }
165|    // 关键词后置分隔符集合
166|    const SEPARATORS: &[char] = &['：', ':', '，', ',', '、', '；', ';', ' ', '（', '('];
167|    has_keyword_after(body, "失败", SEPARATORS) || has_keyword_after(body, "错误", SEPARATORS)
168|}

The elapsed time measures from before `execute_tool_traced` to after, which is correct. But it includes the overhead of the closure, not just the tool execution. This is probably fine for the use case. ### Issue 2: `ToolCallSummary` records `name` AFTER move In line 518: `let out = crate::bot::execute_tool_traced(&app, &name, &args, Some(stop), &trace).await;` The `name: String` parameter is consumed by the `move async` block. Later on line 524: `name` is used in `ToolCallSummary { name, ... }`. This works because `execute_tool_traced` takes `name: &str` (a borrow), so `name` is not consumed. Good. But wait — `execute_tool_traced` signature: `pub async fn execute_tool_traced(app: &AppHandle, name: &str, args: &str, ...)`. It takes `&str`, so `name: String` is just borrowed. OK. ### Issue 3: The audit closure condition `if event == "llm.request"` The `event` parameter in `ModelLoopDeps::audit` is `&'static str`. The comparison works. The string literal `"llm.request"` is hardcoded. Looking at the `audit` callback signature in `ModelLoopDeps`: ```rust pub audit: &'a (dyn Fn(crate::audit::AuditLevel, &'static str, Vec<(&'static str, String)>) + Send + Sync), ``` And the closure uses `event: &'static str`, comparison `if event == "llm.request"` works. ### Issue 4: Atomic ordering for `turn_count` The atomic uses `Relaxed` ordering. Since the counter is just being incremented and read once at the end, `Relaxed` is sufficient — there's no need to synchronize other data with the counter. So this is fine. ### Issue 5: `as_millis() as u64` For elapsed time, `as_millis()` returns `u128`. `as u64` cast — practical tool execution time should never exceed u64. OK. But the confirmed finding #5 says `turn_count: round_count.load(...) as u32` is an unchecked `usize → u32` cast. That's already noted. ### Issue 6: `name` parameter shadowing/move In the closure: ```rust let execute_tool = |name: String, args: String, trace: crate::bot::ToolCallTrace| { let app = app.clone(); let sink = tool_trace_for_exec.clone(); async move { let t0 = std::time::Instant::now(); let out = crate::bot::execute_tool_traced(&app, &name, &args, Some(stop), &trace).await; ... if let Ok(mut sink) = sink.lock() { sink.push(crate::evolution::trace::ToolCallSummary { name, // <-- moves `name` into the struct ... }); } out // <-- `out` is returned } }; ``` The closure moves `name` into `ToolCallSummary`. This is OK. ### Issue 7: AtomicUsize::load in the .map closure with concurrent writes There's a subtle race in `.map(|(text, refs)| { ... })`. The order of operations: 1. `round_count.load(...)` — read 2. `tool_trace.lock()...` — lock and clone (or take) If `tool_trace` has any data still being pushed while the loop is in its terminal state (which shouldn't happen because all awaits have completed), this could race. But since we `.await` the `run_model_loop_core` first and only then call `.map(...)`, there are no concurrent writes happening. So this is fine. ### Issue 8: Audit event magic string (already noted in confirmed findings) ### Issue 9: The new code path bypasses `audit::tool_call_failed` improvements Wait — looking at the audit module, the T3 B1 introduces `ToolStatus` (Ok/Warn/Error). But it's not a bug, since `tool_call_failed` is documented as "全链路唯一真相源". So it's consistent with the rest of the codebase. But it's a missed opportunity to use the structured field. Actually, let me look at this more carefully. The new wrapper calls `tool_call_failed(&name, &out.text)` but the tool returned with a `ToolResult { text, refs, status }`. The `tool_call_failed` function does string matching on text. There's a risk that: 1. A tool returns `status: ToolStatus::Error` with text that doesn't match `tool_call_failed` patterns → `success: true` recorded but really an error. 2. A tool returns `status: ToolStatus::Ok` with text that happens to contain "失败" somewhere → `success: false` recorded but actually success. This is a real correctness issue. So `turn_count` increments even when the loop is being aborted mid-round. This means `turn_count` may exceed the actual rounds completed. Hmm, is that a bug? Let me think about this more carefully. The `turn_count` semantic: "LLM 轮数（llm.request 事件数）". If `llm.request` is counted before the request actually completes, then a "stopped mid-retry" round would still increment `turn_count`. This is a semantic ambiguity. Looking at the code flow: 1. `llm.request` audit emitted (counter increments) 2. Retry loop starts 3. Send request, get response 4. If `stop.stopped()` between retries, return early 5. Counter is now +1 but no actual LLM interaction occurred (well, it did at least once) Actually, the audit was emitted before any request was even sent (line 780, retry loop starts at line 794). So a fast `/stop` between `llm.request` audit and `req.send()` would still count as a turn. But wait — looking more carefully, the comment says "LLM 请求前记录" (record before LLM request). It's a semantic question: does an aborted "llm.request" still count as a turn? I'd argue no — the round didn't actually communicate with the LLM. But the current implementation says yes. This is more of a design ambiguity than a clear bug. I'll note it but it's debatable. ### Checking the `_` import pattern The closure captures `&app`, but the audit callback signature is `Fn(crate::audit::AuditLevel, &'static str, Vec<(&'static str, String)>)`. The `&app` borrow is used inside the closure. The closure captures `app: &AppHandle` (the outer reference). The `app.clone()` is moved into the `async move` block. This is fine. But wait — there's a subtle issue. The `audit` closure does: ```rust &|level, event, kv| { if event == "llm.request" { round_for_audit.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed); } crate::audit::write_event(&app, level, event, &kv) } ``` `round_for_audit` is `Arc<AtomicUsize>`, captured by clone into the closure. `&app` is captured by reference. The closure type: `Fn(AuditLevel, &'static str, Vec<(&'static str, String)>)`. It mutates state via `fetch_add` on `Arc<AtomicUsize>` (atomic, no exclusive borrow needed) and reads `app: &AppHandle`. 1|//! 五个核心指标计算（spec R1）
2|//!
3|//! 1. 任务成功率 task_success_rate = succeeded / total
4|//! 2. 工具调用效率 tool_call_efficiency = successful_tool_calls / total_tool_calls
5|//! 3. 行为偏差 behavior_deviation = 1 - fraction(预期行为命中)
6|//! 4. 回滚率 rollback_rate = rollbacks / applied
7|//! 5. 污染存活期 pollution_survival_days = avg(applied_at 未滑动的天数)
8|//!
9|//! 纯函数，不调 LLM；只读 evolution-applied.jsonl + mem_items 状态。

14|/// 指标计算结果（一轮评估输出）
15|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
16|pub struct MetricsReport {
17|    /// 评估 case 总数
18|    pub case_total: usize,
19|    /// 评估 case 成功数（基于 expected_behavior 命中）
20|    pub case_passed: usize,
21|    /// B4-1 标注：case_passed 恒等于 case_total（无 case 级判定，100% 占位）——
22|    /// 消费方据此把 task_success_rate 显示为「占位」而非真实指标；
23|    /// serde default 兼容旧结果 jsonl（缺字段按 false 读）
24|    #[serde(default)]
25|    pub case_passed_placeholder: bool,
26|    /// 任务成功率（0.0-1.0）
27|    pub task_success_rate: f64,
28|    /// 工具调用总次数（来自反馈 + applied 记录）
29|    pub tool_calls_total: u64,
30|    pub tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
31|    /// 工具调用效率
32|    pub tool_call_efficiency: f64,
33|    /// 行为偏差（0.0-1.0；越大越偏离）
34|    pub behavior_deviation: f64,
35|    /// 已应用提案数
36|    pub applied_total: u64,
37|    /// 回滚数
38|    pub rolled_back_total: u64,
39|    /// 回滚率
40|    pub rollback_rate: f64,
41|    /// 当前仍存活的 lesson 数（污染存活）

43|    /// 污染存活期（天；仅对当前存活 lesson 求均值）
44|    pub pollution_survival_days: f64,
45|    /// 评估时刻（epoch ms）
46|    pub evaluated_at_ms: i64,
47|    /// 评估周期标签（手动 / "before" / "after"）

49|}

53|pub struct AppliedRecord {

61|/// 读 evolution-applied.jsonl；缺文件返回空 vec
62|pub fn read_applied(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<AppliedRecord>, String> {
63|    use std::io::BufRead;
64|    if !path.exists() {
65|        return Ok(Vec::new());
66|    }
67|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
68|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
69|    let mut out = Vec::new();
70|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
71|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
72|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
73|            continue;
74|        }
75|        out.push(
76|            serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| format!("第 {} 行 JSON 错误：{e}", i + 1))?,
77|        );
78|    }
79|    Ok(out)
80|}

82|/// 计算回滚率（基于当前 mem_items 状态）
83|///
84|/// 已应用 = applied.jsonl 行数；
85|/// 仍存在 = 当前 mem_items 中 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的条目数；
86|/// 已回滚 = 已应用 - 仍存在。
87|pub fn rollback_rate(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> f64 {
88|    if applied.is_empty() {
89|        return 0.0;
90|    }
91|    rollback_count(applied, live_keys) as f64 / applied.len() as f64
92|}
93|
94|/// 已回滚条数（**整数真源**，OCR C3-2）。
95|/// `rollback_rate` 与 `rolled_back_total` 共用本函数：后者原先 `(len as f64 * rb_rate) as u64`
96|/// 存在 IEEE-754 回程误差（2/3×3 → 1.999… → 截断成 1），与 `rb_rate` 字段自相矛盾。
97|pub fn rollback_count(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> u64 {
98|    let live: HashMap<&str, ()> = live_keys.iter().map(|k| (k.as_str(), ())).collect();
99|    applied
100|        .iter()
101|        .filter(|r| !live.contains_key(r.mem_key.as_str()))
102|        .count() as u64
103|}
104|
105|/// 污染存活期（天；当前仍存活 lesson 的 (now - applied_at) 均值）
106|///
107|/// `applied_at_lookup`: mem_key → applied_at_ms（applied.jsonl 的索引）
108|pub fn pollution_survival_days(
109|    live_keys: &[String],
110|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
111|    now_ms: i64,
112|) -> f64 {
113|    let lookup: HashMap<&str, i64> = applied
114|        .iter()
115|        .map(|r| (r.mem_key.as_str(), r.applied_at_ms))
116|        .collect();
117|    let mut total_days = 0.0;
118|    let mut n = 0u64;
119|    for k in live_keys {
120|        if let Some(at) = lookup.get(k.as_str()) {
121|            let days = (now_ms - *at) as f64 / 86_400_000.0;
122|            if days >= 0.0 {
123|                total_days += days;
124|                n += 1;
125|            }
126|        }
127|    }
128|    if n == 0 {
129|        0.0
130|    } else {
131|        total_days / n as f64
132|    }
133|}
134|
135|/// 行为偏差：对每个 case 的 expected_behavior 列表，统计命中率；
136|/// deviation = 1 - avg(hit_fraction)。
137|/// `actual_hits`: case_id → 实际命中的 expected_behavior 子集
138|pub fn behavior_deviation(case_total: usize, hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)]) -> f64 {
139|    if case_total == 0 {
140|        return 0.0;
141|    }
142|    let avg: f64 = if hit_fractions.is_empty() {
143|        1.0
144|    } else {
145|        hit_fractions.iter().map(|(_, f)| *f).sum::<f64>() / hit_fractions.len() as f64
146|    };
147|    (1.0 - avg).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
148|}

150|/// 主入口：聚合全部指标
151|pub fn compute(
152|    case_total: usize,
153|    case_passed: usize,
154|    tool_calls_total: u64,
155|    tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
156|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
157|    live_keys: &[String],
158|    hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)],
159|    now_ms: i64,
160|    period: impl Into<String>,
161|) -> MetricsReport {
162|    let task_success_rate = if case_total == 0 {
163|        0.0
164|    } else {
165|        case_passed as f64 / case_total as f64
166|    };
167|    let tool_call_efficiency = if tool_calls_total == 0 {
168|        0.0
169|    } else {
170|        tool_calls_succeeded as f64 / tool_calls_total as f64
171|    };
172|    let dev = behavior_deviation(case_total, hit_fractions);
173|    let rb_rate = rollback_rate(applied, live_keys);
174|    let survival = pollution_survival_days(live_keys, applied, now_ms);
175|    MetricsReport {
176|        case_total,
177|        case_passed,
178|        task_success_rate,
179|        // B4-1：当前无 case 级判定，task_success_rate 是 100% 占位——输出里显式
180|        // 标注，消费方不再把占位值当真实指标
181|        case_passed_placeholder: true,
182|        tool_calls_total,
183|        tool_calls_succeeded,
184|        tool_call_efficiency,
185|        behavior_deviation: dev,
186|        applied_total: applied.len() as u64,
187|        rolled_back_total: rollback_count(applied, live_keys),
188|        rollback_rate: rb_rate,
189|        live_lessons: live_keys.len() as u64,
190|        pollution_survival_days: survival,
191|        evaluated_at_ms: now_ms,
192|        period: period.into(),
193|    }
194|}

Good - the test in `runner.rs` correctly includes the new `case_passed_placeholder` field in the test struct construction. 1|//! 五个核心指标计算（spec R1）
2|//!
3|//! 1. 任务成功率 task_success_rate = succeeded / total
4|//! 2. 工具调用效率 tool_call_efficiency = successful_tool_calls / total_tool_calls
5|//! 3. 行为偏差 behavior_deviation = 1 - fraction(预期行为命中)
6|//! 4. 回滚率 rollback_rate = rollbacks / applied
7|//! 5. 污染存活期 pollution_survival_days = avg(applied_at 未滑动的天数)
8|//!
9|//! 纯函数，不调 LLM；只读 evolution-applied.jsonl + mem_items 状态。
10|
11|use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
12|use std::collections::HashMap;
13|
14|/// 指标计算结果（一轮评估输出）
15|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
16|pub struct MetricsReport {
17|    /// 评估 case 总数
18|    pub case_total: usize,
19|    /// 评估 case 成功数（基于 expected_behavior 命中）
20|    pub case_passed: usize,
21|    /// B4-1 标注：case_passed 恒等于 case_total（无 case 级判定，100% 占位）——
22|    /// 消费方据此把 task_success_rate 显示为「占位」而非真实指标；
23|    /// serde default 兼容旧结果 jsonl（缺字段按 false 读）
24|    #[serde(default)]
25|    pub case_passed_placeholder: bool,
26|    /// 任务成功率（0.0-1.0）
27|    pub task_success_rate: f64,
28|    /// 工具调用总次数（来自反馈 + applied 记录）
29|    pub tool_calls_total: u64,
30|    pub tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
31|    /// 工具调用效率
32|    pub tool_call_efficiency: f64,
33|    /// 行为偏差（0.0-1.0；越大越偏离）
34|    pub behavior_deviation: f64,
35|    /// 已应用提案数
36|    pub applied_total: u64,
37|    /// 回滚数
38|    pub rolled_back_total: u64,
39|    /// 回滚率
40|    pub rollback_rate: f64,
41|    /// 当前仍存活的 lesson 数（污染存活）
42|    pub live_lessons: u64,
43|    /// 污染存活期（天；仅对当前存活 lesson 求均值）
44|    pub pollution_survival_days: f64,
45|    /// 评估时刻（epoch ms）
46|    pub evaluated_at_ms: i64,
47|    /// 评估周期标签（手动 / "before" / "after"）
48|    pub period: String,
49|}
50|
51|/// 单条 applied 记录（读 evolution-applied.jsonl）
52|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
53|pub struct AppliedRecord {
54|    pub proposal_id: String,
55|    pub mem_key: String,
56|    pub applied_at_ms: i64,
57|    pub impact: String,
58|    pub summary: String,
59|}
60|
61|/// 读 evolution-applied.jsonl；缺文件返回空 vec
62|pub fn read_applied(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<AppliedRecord>, String> {
63|    use std::io::BufRead;
64|    if !path.exists() {
65|        return Ok(Vec::new());
66|    }
67|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
68|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
69|    let mut out = Vec::new();
70|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
71|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
72|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
73|            continue;
74|        }
75|        out.push(
76|            serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| format!("第 {} 行 JSON 错误：{e}", i + 1))?,
77|        );
78|    }
79|    Ok(out)
80|}
81|
82|/// 计算回滚率（基于当前 mem_items 状态）
83|///
84|/// 已应用 = applied.jsonl 行数；
85|/// 仍存在 = 当前 mem_items 中 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的条目数；
86|/// 已回滚 = 已应用 - 仍存在。
87|pub fn rollback_rate(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> f64 {
88|    if applied.is_empty() {
89|        return 0.0;
90|    }
91|    rollback_count(applied, live_keys) as f64 / applied.len() as f64
92|}
93|
94|/// 已回滚条数（**整数真源**，OCR C3-2）。
95|/// `rollback_rate` 与 `rolled_back_total` 共用本函数：后者原先 `(len as f64 * rb_rate) as u64`
96|/// 存在 IEEE-754 回程误差（2/3×3 → 1.999… → 截断成 1），与 `rb_rate` 字段自相矛盾。
97|pub fn rollback_count(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> u64 {
98|    let live: HashMap<&str, ()> = live_keys.iter().map(|k| (k.as_str(), ())).collect();
99|    applied
100|        .iter()
101|        .filter(|r| !live.contains_key(r.mem_key.as_str()))
102|        .count() as u64
103|}
104|
105|/// 污染存活期（天；当前仍存活 lesson 的 (now - applied_at) 均值）
106|///
107|/// `applied_at_lookup`: mem_key → applied_at_ms（applied.jsonl 的索引）
108|pub fn pollution_survival_days(
109|    live_keys: &[String],
110|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
111|    now_ms: i64,
112|) -> f64 {
113|    let lookup: HashMap<&str, i64> = applied
114|        .iter()
115|        .map(|r| (r.mem_key.as_str(), r.applied_at_ms))
116|        .collect();
117|    let mut total_days = 0.0;
118|    let mut n = 0u64;
119|    for k in live_keys {
120|        if let Some(at) = lookup.get(k.as_str()) {
121|            let days = (now_ms - *at) as f64 / 86_400_000.0;
122|            if days >= 0.0 {
123|                total_days += days;
124|                n += 1;
125|            }
126|        }
127|    }
128|    if n == 0 {
129|        0.0
130|    } else {
131|        total_days / n as f64
132|    }
133|}
134|
135|/// 行为偏差：对每个 case 的 expected_behavior 列表，统计命中率；
136|/// deviation = 1 - avg(hit_fraction)。
137|/// `actual_hits`: case_id → 实际命中的 expected_behavior 子集
138|pub fn behavior_deviation(case_total: usize, hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)]) -> f64 {
139|    if case_total == 0 {
140|        return 0.0;
141|    }
142|    let avg: f64 = if hit_fractions.is_empty() {
143|        1.0
144|    } else {
145|        hit_fractions.iter().map(|(_, f)| *f).sum::<f64>() / hit_fractions.len() as f64
146|    };
147|    (1.0 - avg).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
148|}
149|
150|/// 主入口：聚合全部指标
151|pub fn compute(
152|    case_total: usize,
153|    case_passed: usize,
154|    tool_calls_total: u64,
155|    tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
156|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
157|    live_keys: &[String],
158|    hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)],
159|    now_ms: i64,
160|    period: impl Into<String>,
161|) -> MetricsReport {
162|    let task_success_rate = if case_total == 0 {
163|        0.0
164|    } else {
165|        case_passed as f64 / case_total as f64
166|    };
167|    let tool_call_efficiency = if tool_calls_total == 0 {
168|        0.0
169|    } else {
170|        tool_calls_succeeded as f64 / tool_calls_total as f64
171|    };
172|    let dev = behavior_deviation(case_total, hit_fractions);
173|    let rb_rate = rollback_rate(applied, live_keys);
174|    let survival = pollution_survival_days(live_keys, applied, now_ms);
175|    MetricsReport {
176|        case_total,
177|        case_passed,
178|        task_success_rate,
179|        // B4-1：当前无 case 级判定，task_success_rate 是 100% 占位——输出里显式
180|        // 标注，消费方不再把占位值当真实指标
181|        case_passed_placeholder: true,
182|        tool_calls_total,
183|        tool_calls_succeeded,
184|        tool_call_efficiency,
185|        behavior_deviation: dev,
186|        applied_total: applied.len() as u64,
187|        rolled_back_total: rollback_count(applied, live_keys),
188|        rollback_rate: rb_rate,
189|        live_lessons: live_keys.len() as u64,
190|        pollution_survival_days: survival,
191|        evaluated_at_ms: now_ms,
192|        period: period.into(),
193|    }
194|}

1|//! EvalRunner —— 跑一轮评估、产出 MetricsReport
2|//!
3|//! 流程：
4|//!   1. 加载 eval_set.jsonl → EvalCase 列表
5|//!   2. 加载 evolution-applied.jsonl → AppliedRecord 列表

9|//!   6. 追加写 evolution-eval-results.jsonl + 打印到 stdout

22|/// 跑一轮评估，返回 MetricsReport
23|///
24|/// `period` 标签："manual" / "before" / "after" / 自定义
25|/// `db_path`：dev SQLite 文件路径（None 时跳过 mem_items 状态读取，回滚率/存活期=0）
26|/// `applied_path`：B4-1 覆盖（CLI `--applied`）；None 按优先级推导
27|///（db 同目录 > eval_set 同目录兜底）
28|pub fn run(
29|    cfg: &EvolutionEvalConfig,
30|    db_path: Option<&Path>,
31|    applied_path: Option<&Path>,
32|    period: &str,
33|) -> Result<MetricsReport, String> {
34|    // 1. eval set
35|    let cases: Vec<EvalCase> = read_jsonl(&cfg.eval_set_path)?;
36|    // 2. applied（B4-1：路径推导修正）
37|    let applied_path = resolve_applied_path(cfg, db_path, applied_path);
38|    let applied = read_applied(&applied_path)?;
39|    // 3. live keys
40|    let live_keys: Vec<String> = if let Some(p) = db_path {
41|        list_live_lesson_keys(p)?
42|    } else {
43|        Vec::new()
44|    };
45|    // 4. feedback
46|    let feedback = read_feedback(&cfg.feedback_path)?;
47|    let (tool_total, tool_ok, hit_fractions) = aggregate_feedback(&cases, &feedback);
48|    // 5. compute
49|    let now_ms = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis();
50|    let report = compute(
51|        cases.len(),
52|        cases.len(), // B4-1 标注：无 case 级判定，恒 100% 占位（MetricsReport.case_passed_placeholder=true）；R2 接入 ChangeRecord 后实判
53|        tool_total,
54|        tool_ok,
55|        &applied,
56|        &live_keys,
57|        &hit_fractions,
58|        now_ms,
59|        period,
60|    );
61|    Ok(report)
62|}

64|/// 把 eval 结果追加到 evolution-eval-results.jsonl
65|pub fn append_result(path: &Path, report: &MetricsReport) -> Result<(), String> {
66|    use std::io::Write;
67|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
68|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
69|    }
70|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
71|        .create(true)
72|        .append(true)
73|        .open(path)
74|        .map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
75|    let line =
76|        serde_json::to_string(report).map_err(|e| format!("序列化 MetricsReport 失败：{e}"))?;
77|    writeln!(f, "{line}").map_err(|e| format!("写入 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
78|    Ok(())
79|}

81|/// 列出当前 mem_items 里 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的 mem_key
82|///
83|/// 只读；缺表返回空 vec（dev DB 没建表时不 panic）
84|fn list_live_lesson_keys(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
85|    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 DB {db_path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
86|    let exists: i64 = conn
87|        .query_row(
88|            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mem_items'",
89|            [],
90|            |r| r.get(0),
91|        )
92|        .map_err(|e| format!("查 mem_items 表失败：{e}"))?;
93|    if exists == 0 {
94|        return Ok(Vec::new());
95|    }
96|    let mut stmt = conn
97|        .prepare("SELECT tags FROM mem_items WHERE kind='lesson'")
98|        .map_err(|e| format!("prepare mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
99|    let rows = stmt
100|        .query_map([], |r| {
101|            let tags: String = r.get(0)?;
102|            Ok(tags)
103|        })
104|        .map_err(|e| format!("query mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
105|    let mut keys = Vec::new();
106|    for row in rows {
107|        let tags = row.map_err(|e| format!("read row 失败：{e}"))?;
108|        // tags 是逗号分隔；取第一段
109|        if let Some(first) = tags.split(',').next() {
110|            let first = first.trim();
111|            if first.starts_with("evo:") {
112|                keys.push(first.to_string());
113|            }
114|        }
115|    }
116|    Ok(keys)
117|}

119|/// 把 feedback 按 session / case 聚合
120|fn aggregate_feedback(
121|    cases: &[EvalCase],
122|    feedback: &[FeedbackEntry],
123|) -> (u64, u64, Vec<(String, f64)>) {
124|    // tool_calls: 全部 ToolError 信号视为失败调用，task_complete 视为成功调用
125|    let mut total: u64 = 0;
126|    let mut succeeded: u64 = 0;
127|    for f in feedback {
128|        match f.signal_type {
129|            SignalType::ToolError => {
130|                total += 1;
131|                // value 0.0/1.0 = 失败/不一定（按 0 算）
132|            }
133|            SignalType::TaskComplete => {
134|                total += 1;
135|                succeeded += 1;
136|            }
137|            SignalType::TaskFailed => {
138|                total += 1;
139|            }
140|            _ => {}
141|        }
142|    }
143|    // hit_fractions: 对每个 case 检查 feedback 里 thumbs_up / thumbs_down 比例
144|    let mut hit_fractions: Vec<(String, f64)> = Vec::new();
145|    for c in cases {
146|        let related: Vec<&FeedbackEntry> = feedback
147|            .iter()
148|            .filter(|f| {
149|                f.case_id.as_deref() == Some(c.case_id.as_str()) || f.session_id == c.case_id
150|            })
151|            .collect();
152|        if related.is_empty() {
153|            hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), 1.0));
154|            continue;
155|        }
156|        let pos = related
157|            .iter()
158|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsUp))
159|            .count() as f64;
160|        let neg = related
161|            .iter()
162|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsDown))
163|            .count() as f64;
164|        let frac = if pos + neg > 0.0 {
165|            pos / (pos + neg)
166|        } else {
167|            1.0
168|        };
169|        hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), frac));
170|    }
171|    (total, succeeded, hit_fractions)
172|}

174|// EvolutionEvalConfig 扩展：applied 路径兜底推导。B4-1（P2-EV8）：真实路径
175|// 优先级 = 显式 --applied > db_path 同目录（applied.jsonl 与 DB 同在 data_dir）
176|// > 此兜底；此前直接用本兜底会读到 `<eval_set>.applied.jsonl`（不存在 → 空
177|// applied → 回滚率/污染存活期恒 0）
178|trait ConfigExt {
179|    fn eval_set_path_with_applied(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf;
180|}
181|impl ConfigExt for EvolutionEvalConfig {
182|    fn eval_set_path_with_applied(&self) -> std::path::PathBuf {
183|        let mut p = self.eval_set_path.clone();
184|        p.set_extension("applied.jsonl");
185|        p
186|    }
187|}
188|
189|/// B4-1：applied.jsonl 路径解析（--applied 覆盖 > db 同目录 > 兜底）
190|pub(crate) fn resolve_applied_path(
191|    cfg: &EvolutionEvalConfig,
192|    db_path: Option<&Path>,
193|    applied_override: Option<&Path>,
194|) -> std::path::PathBuf {
195|    applied_override
196|        .map(Path::to_path_buf)
197|        .or_else(|| db_path.and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("evolution-applied.jsonl"))))
198|        .unwrap_or_else(|| cfg.eval_set_path_with_applied())
199|}

1|//! 五个核心指标计算（spec R1）
2|//!
3|//! 1. 任务成功率 task_success_rate = succeeded / total
4|//! 2. 工具调用效率 tool_call_efficiency = successful_tool_calls / total_tool_calls
5|//! 3. 行为偏差 behavior_deviation = 1 - fraction(预期行为命中)
6|//! 4. 回滚率 rollback_rate = rollbacks / applied
7|//! 5. 污染存活期 pollution_survival_days = avg(applied_at 未滑动的天数)
8|//!
9|//! 纯函数，不调 LLM；只读 evolution-applied.jsonl + mem_items 状态。
10|
11|use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
12|use std::collections::HashMap;
13|
14|/// 指标计算结果（一轮评估输出）
15|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
16|pub struct MetricsReport {
17|    /// 评估 case 总数
18|    pub case_total: usize,
19|    /// 评估 case 成功数（基于 expected_behavior 命中）
20|    pub case_passed: usize,
21|    /// B4-1 标注：case_passed 恒等于 case_total（无 case 级判定，100% 占位）——
22|    /// 消费方据此把 task_success_rate 显示为「占位」而非真实指标；
23|    /// serde default 兼容旧结果 jsonl（缺字段按 false 读）
24|    #[serde(default)]
25|    pub case_passed_placeholder: bool,
26|    /// 任务成功率（0.0-1.0）
27|    pub task_success_rate: f64,
28|    /// 工具调用总次数（来自反馈 + applied 记录）
29|    pub tool_calls_total: u64,
30|    pub tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
31|    /// 工具调用效率
32|    pub tool_call_efficiency: f64,
33|    /// 行为偏差（0.0-1.0；越大越偏离）
34|    pub behavior_deviation: f64,
35|    /// 已应用提案数
36|    pub applied_total: u64,
37|    /// 回滚数
38|    pub rolled_back_total: u64,
39|    /// 回滚率
40|    pub rollback_rate: f64,
41|    /// 当前仍存活的 lesson 数（污染存活）
42|    pub live_lessons: u64,
43|    /// 污染存活期（天；仅对当前存活 lesson 求均值）
44|    pub pollution_survival_days: f64,
45|    /// 评估时刻（epoch ms）
46|    pub evaluated_at_ms: i64,
47|    /// 评估周期标签（手动 / "before" / "after"）
48|    pub period: String,
49|}
50|
51|/// 单条 applied 记录（读 evolution-applied.jsonl）
52|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
53|pub struct AppliedRecord {
54|    pub proposal_id: String,
55|    pub mem_key: String,
56|    pub applied_at_ms: i64,
57|    pub impact: String,
58|    pub summary: String,
59|}
60|
61|/// 读 evolution-applied.jsonl；缺文件返回空 vec
62|pub fn read_applied(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<AppliedRecord>, String> {
63|    use std::io::BufRead;
64|    if !path.exists() {
65|        return Ok(Vec::new());
66|    }
67|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
68|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
69|    let mut out = Vec::new();
70|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
71|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
72|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
73|            continue;
74|        }
75|        out.push(
76|            serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| format!("第 {} 行 JSON 错误：{e}", i + 1))?,
77|        );
78|    }
79|    Ok(out)
80|}
81|
82|/// 计算回滚率（基于当前 mem_items 状态）
83|///
84|/// 已应用 = applied.jsonl 行数；
85|/// 仍存在 = 当前 mem_items 中 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的条目数；
86|/// 已回滚 = 已应用 - 仍存在。
87|pub fn rollback_rate(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> f64 {
88|    if applied.is_empty() {
89|        return 0.0;
90|    }
91|    rollback_count(applied, live_keys) as f64 / applied.len() as f64
92|}
93|
94|/// 已回滚条数（**整数真源**，OCR C3-2）。
95|/// `rollback_rate` 与 `rolled_back_total` 共用本函数：后者原先 `(len as f64 * rb_rate) as u64`
96|/// 存在 IEEE-754 回程误差（2/3×3 → 1.999… → 截断成 1），与 `rb_rate` 字段自相矛盾。
97|pub fn rollback_count(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> u64 {
98|    let live: HashMap<&str, ()> = live_keys.iter().map(|k| (k.as_str(), ())).collect();
99|    applied
100|        .iter()
101|        .filter(|r| !live.contains_key(r.mem_key.as_str()))
102|        .count() as u64
103|}
104|
105|/// 污染存活期（天；当前仍存活 lesson 的 (now - applied_at) 均值）
106|///
107|/// `applied_at_lookup`: mem_key → applied_at_ms（applied.jsonl 的索引）
108|pub fn pollution_survival_days(
109|    live_keys: &[String],
110|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
111|    now_ms: i64,
112|) -> f64 {
113|    let lookup: HashMap<&str, i64> = applied
114|        .iter()
115|        .map(|r| (r.mem_key.as_str(), r.applied_at_ms))
116|        .collect();
117|    let mut total_days = 0.0;
118|    let mut n = 0u64;
119|    for k in live_keys {
120|        if let Some(at) = lookup.get(k.as_str()) {
121|            let days = (now_ms - *at) as f64 / 86_400_000.0;
122|            if days >= 0.0 {
123|                total_days += days;
124|                n += 1;
125|            }
126|        }
127|    }
128|    if n == 0 {
129|        0.0
130|    } else {
131|        total_days / n as f64
132|    }
133|}
134|
135|/// 行为偏差：对每个 case 的 expected_behavior 列表，统计命中率；
136|/// deviation = 1 - avg(hit_fraction)。
137|/// `actual_hits`: case_id → 实际命中的 expected_behavior 子集
138|pub fn behavior_deviation(case_total: usize, hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)]) -> f64 {
139|    if case_total == 0 {
140|        return 0.0;
141|    }
142|    let avg: f64 = if hit_fractions.is_empty() {
143|        1.0
144|    } else {
145|        hit_fractions.iter().map(|(_, f)| *f).sum::<f64>() / hit_fractions.len() as f64
146|    };
147|    (1.0 - avg).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
148|}
149|
150|/// 主入口：聚合全部指标
151|pub fn compute(
152|    case_total: usize,
153|    case_passed: usize,
154|    tool_calls_total: u64,
155|    tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
156|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
157|    live_keys: &[String],
158|    hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)],
159|    now_ms: i64,
160|    period: impl Into<String>,
161|) -> MetricsReport {
162|    let task_success_rate = if case_total == 0 {
163|        0.0
164|    } else {
165|        case_passed as f64 / case_total as f64
166|    };
167|    let tool_call_efficiency = if tool_calls_total == 0 {
168|        0.0
169|    } else {
170|        tool_calls_succeeded as f64 / tool_calls_total as f64
171|    };
172|    let dev = behavior_deviation(case_total, hit_fractions);
173|    let rb_rate = rollback_rate(applied, live_keys);
174|    let survival = pollution_survival_days(live_keys, applied, now_ms);
175|    MetricsReport {
176|        case_total,
177|        case_passed,
178|        task_success_rate,
179|        // B4-1：当前无 case 级判定，task_success_rate 是 100% 占位——输出里显式
180|        // 标注，消费方不再把占位值当真实指标
181|        case_passed_placeholder: true,
182|        tool_calls_total,
183|        tool_calls_succeeded,
184|        tool_call_efficiency,
185|        behavior_deviation: dev,
186|        applied_total: applied.len() as u64,
187|        rolled_back_total: rollback_count(applied, live_keys),
188|        rollback_rate: rb_rate,
189|        live_lessons: live_keys.len() as u64,
190|        pollution_survival_days: survival,
191|        evaluated_at_ms: now_ms,
192|        period: period.into(),
193|    }
194|}

1|//! 评估用例数据结构（R1 L4 评估层）
2|//!
3|//! jsonl 一行一条；schema 严格按 spec：
4|//! `{case_id, source_session_id, input, expected_behavior[], metrics[]}`
5|//!
6|//! 不动 evolution 模块的现有 JSON 字段；新字段独立落 jsonl（解决 VERIFICATION.md 冲突 #2）。

8|use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
9|
10|/// 一条评估用例
11|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
12|pub struct EvalCase {
13|    /// 唯一 id（如 "case-0001"、"test-apply_one_inserts_lesson_with_evolution_key"）
14|    pub case_id: String,
15|    /// 来源 session（从 bot_sessions 采样时填；测试派生时为 None）
16|    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
17|    pub source_session_id: Option<String>,
18|    /// 来源测试函数名（#[test] fn name；采样派生时为 None）
19|    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
20|    pub source_test: Option<String>,
21|    /// 输入/场景描述（自然语言；测试派生时是测试名）
22|    pub input: String,
23|    /// 期望行为列表（按字符串精确匹配；多行为表示同时满足）
24|    pub expected_behavior: Vec<String>,
25|    /// 适用指标（每个指标有权重；评估时聚合）
26|    pub metrics: Vec<MetricSpec>,
27|    /// 分类标签（如 "memory"、"tool"、"safety"）
28|    #[serde(default)]
29|    pub tags: Vec<String>,
30|}
31|
32|/// 指标规格
33|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
34|pub struct MetricSpec {
35|    /// 指标名（与 metrics.rs 的指标枚举对齐）
36|    pub metric: String,
37|    /// 在聚合分中的权重（0.0-1.0）
38|    pub weight: f64,
39|}
40|
41|/// 读 jsonl 为 EvalCase 列表；行格式错误抛 Err 并指出行号
42|pub fn read_jsonl(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<EvalCase>, String> {
43|    use std::io::BufRead;
44|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
45|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
46|    let mut out = Vec::new();
47|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
48|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
49|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
50|            continue;
51|        }
52|        let c: EvalCase =
53|            serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| format!("第 {} 行 JSON 错误：{e}", i + 1))?;
54|        out.push(c);
55|    }
56|    Ok(out)
57|}
58|
59|/// 写 jsonl（追加模式）；保证父目录存在
60|pub fn append_jsonl(path: &std::path::Path, cases: &[EvalCase]) -> Result<(), String> {
61|    use std::io::Write;
62|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
63|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
64|    }
65|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
66|        .create(true)
67|        .append(true)
68|        .open(path)
69|        .map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
70|    for c in cases {
71|        let line = serde_json::to_string(c)
72|            .map_err(|e| format!("序列化 {case_id} 失败：{e}", case_id = c.case_id))?;
73|        writeln!(f, "{line}").map_err(|e| format!("写入 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
74|    }
75|    Ok(())
76|}

61|/// 读 evolution-applied.jsonl；缺文件返回空 vec
62|pub fn read_applied(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<AppliedRecord>, String> {
63|    use std::io::BufRead;
64|    if !path.exists() {
65|        return Ok(Vec::new());
66|    }
67|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
68|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
69|    let mut out = Vec::new();
70|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
71|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
72|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
73|            continue;
74|        }
75|        out.push(
76|            serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| format!("第 {} 行 JSON 错误：{e}", i + 1))?,
77|        );
78|    }
79|    Ok(out)

82|/// 计算回滚率（基于当前 mem_items 状态）
83|///
84|/// 已应用 = applied.jsonl 行数；
85|/// 仍存在 = 当前 mem_items 中 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的条目数；
86|/// 已回滚 = 已应用 - 仍存在。
87|pub fn rollback_rate(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> f64 {
88|    if applied.is_empty() {
89|        return 0.0;
90|    }
91|    rollback_count(applied, live_keys) as f64 / applied.len() as f64
92|}
93|
94|/// 已回滚条数（**整数真源**，OCR C3-2）。
95|/// `rollback_rate` 与 `rolled_back_total` 共用本函数：后者原先 `(len as f64 * rb_rate) as u64`
96|/// 存在 IEEE-754 回程误差（2/3×3 → 1.999… → 截断成 1），与 `rb_rate` 字段自相矛盾。
97|pub fn rollback_count(applied: &[AppliedRecord], live_keys: &[String]) -> u64 {
98|    let live: HashMap<&str, ()> = live_keys.iter().map(|k| (k.as_str(), ())).collect();
99|    applied
100|        .iter()
101|        .filter(|r| !live.contains_key(r.mem_key.as_str()))
102|        .count() as u64
103|}
104|
105|/// 污染存活期（天；当前仍存活 lesson 的 (now - applied_at) 均值）
106|///
107|/// `applied_at_lookup`: mem_key → applied_at_ms（applied.jsonl 的索引）
108|pub fn pollution_survival_days(
109|    live_keys: &[String],
110|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
111|    now_ms: i64,
112|) -> f64 {
113|    let lookup: HashMap<&str, i64> = applied
114|        .iter()
115|        .map(|r| (r.mem_key.as_str(), r.applied_at_ms))
116|        .collect();
117|    let mut total_days = 0.0;
118|    let mut n = 0u64;
119|    for k in live_keys {
120|        if let Some(at) = lookup.get(k.as_str()) {
121|            let days = (now_ms - *at) as f64 / 86_400_000.0;
122|            if days >= 0.0 {
123|                total_days += days;
124|                n += 1;
125|            }
126|        }
127|    }
128|    if n == 0 {
129|        0.0
130|    } else {
131|        total_days / n as f64
132|    }
133|}
134|
135|/// 行为偏差：对每个 case 的 expected_behavior 列表，统计命中率；
136|/// deviation = 1 - avg(hit_fraction)。
137|/// `actual_hits`: case_id → 实际命中的 expected_behavior 子集
138|pub fn behavior_deviation(case_total: usize, hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)]) -> f64 {
139|    if case_total == 0 {
140|        return 0.0;
141|    }
142|    let avg: f64 = if hit_fractions.is_empty() {
143|        1.0
144|    } else {
145|        hit_fractions.iter().map(|(_, f)| *f).sum::<f64>() / hit_fractions.len() as f64
146|    };
147|    (1.0 - avg).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
148|}

150|/// 主入口：聚合全部指标
151|pub fn compute(
152|    case_total: usize,
153|    case_passed: usize,
154|    tool_calls_total: u64,
155|    tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
156|    applied: &[AppliedRecord],
157|    live_keys: &[String],
158|    hit_fractions: &[(String, f64)],
159|    now_ms: i64,
160|    period: impl Into<String>,
161|) -> MetricsReport {
162|    let task_success_rate = if case_total == 0 {
163|        0.0
164|    } else {
165|        case_passed as f64 / case_total as f64
166|    };
167|    let tool_call_efficiency = if tool_calls_total == 0 {
168|        0.0
169|    } else {
170|        tool_calls_succeeded as f64 / tool_calls_total as f64
171|    };
172|    let dev = behavior_deviation(case_total, hit_fractions);
173|    let rb_rate = rollback_rate(applied, live_keys);
174|    let survival = pollution_survival_days(live_keys, applied, now_ms);
175|    MetricsReport {
176|        case_total,
177|        case_passed,

190|        pollution_survival_days: survival,
191|        evaluated_at_ms: now_ms,
192|        period: period.into(),
193|    }

The new code at line 197 hardcodes this constant. While consistent with `observe_run.rs` and `apply.rs`, this represents a possible refactoring opportunity (e.g., a constant), but it's not a critical issue. 2. **`db_path` edge case** - In `resolve_applied_path()`, `db_path.and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("evolution-applied.jsonl")))`. If `db_path` is a bare filename like `"foo.db"` (no parent dir components), `Path::parent()` returns `Some(PathBuf::from(""))`, and `d.join("evolution-applied.jsonl")` would produce `PathBuf::from("evolution-applied.jsonl")` (current dir). This isn't really wrong but could produce surprising behavior when CWD isn't what the user expects. 3. **Misleading function name** - `eval_set_path_with_applied()` is poorly named now since it just produces a `.applied.jsonl` extension, which is a different convention from the actual `evolution-applied.jsonl`. The comment at line 174-177 mentions the convention `evolution-applied.jsonl` but the function actually produces `<eval_set>.applied.jsonl`. This naming inconsistency is now an issue because the function is only used as a last-resort fallback. I see a potential bug here: `Path::set_extension("applied.jsonl")` - In Rust, `set_extension` replaces the file extension. If `eval_set_path` is `eval_set.jsonl`, then after `set_extension("applied.jsonl")` the path would be `eval_set.applied.jsonl`. Let me verify this is intentional and matches what the original code intended (yes it does - `<eval_set>.applied.jsonl` is the historical fallback). Now let me consider the most critical concerns: 1. **`Path::set_extension("applied.jsonl")` behavior** - Let me verify what Rust's `set_extension` actually does when given a multi-segment extension. According to Rust docs, `set_extension` with `"applied.jsonl"` would set the file name to have `.applied.jsonl` extension. Actually, `set_extension` in Rust replaces only the final extension part. So if you call `set_extension("applied.jsonl")` on a file `foo.jsonl`, the result would be `foo.applied.jsonl` (it sets the final extension, so `.jsonl` is replaced with `.applied.jsonl`). Wait, that's actually correct behavior - the comment says `<eval_set>.applied.jsonl` which is what `set_extension("applied.jsonl")` produces. 2. **`db_path.parent()` returning `Some("")`** - This is a potential edge case. If `db_path` is `"foo.db"` (just filename, no directory), then `parent()` returns `Some(Path::new(""))`, and joining `"evolution-applied.jsonl"` to it gives just `"evolution-applied.jsonl"` (PathBuf::join normalizes the empty path). This is technically OK but the resulting behavior of falling back to current working dir might not be what the user wants. However, this isn't really a bug per se. 3. **Misleading `ConfigExt` documentation** - The comment block above `ConfigExt` (lines 174-177) is now misleading because the function is only a fallback. The naming `eval_set_path_with_applied()` is also somewhat confusing because the convention is `evolution-applied.jsonl` (not `eval_set_path_with_applied.jsonl`). The naming was already misleading before, but now it's clear it's just used as a fallback to an incorrect assumption. 4. **Public trait `ConfigExt`** - The `ConfigExt` trait is private (no `pub`), but its method is used by `pub(crate) fn resolve_applied_path`. This means the trait cannot be reused outside the module. This is fine. Let me verify the behavior of `set_extension` once more by reading the Rust documentation more carefully. According to Rust docs: > If `extension` is the empty string, `self.extension()` will be `None` after the call. Otherwise, the path will have the specified extension. If `self.file_name()` is `None`, `set_extension` is a no-op. When `extension` is `"applied.jsonl"`, Rust interprets it as setting the extension to `"applied.jsonl"` - so `foo.jsonl` becomes `foo.applied.jsonl`. This is correct for the fallback case. 67|pub fn copy_legacy_db(
68|    legacy_db: &std::path::Path,
69|    db_path: &std::path::Path,
70|) -> Result<Vec<String>, CommandError> {
71|    let mut warns = Vec::new();
72|
73|    // checkpoint section（不变）
74|    match rusqlite::Connection::open(legacy_db) {
75|        Ok(conn) => match conn.query_row("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);", [], |r| {
76|            r.get::<_, i64>(0)
77|        }) {
78|            Ok(0) => {}
79|            Ok(_) => warns.push(
80|                "老库 WAL checkpoint 被占（BUSY），WAL 未落主库——-wal/-shm 已一并拷贝".to_string(),
81|            ),
82|            Err(e) => {
83|                // BUSY（源库被其他连接占用）是良性：-wal/-shm 原样带走即可继续；
84|                // 其余（损坏 NOTADB / IO 等）= 源库不可信，与 open 失败同治：fail-closed。
85|                if e.sqlite_error_code() == Some(rusqlite::ErrorCode::DatabaseBusy) {
86|                    warns.push(
87|                        "老库 WAL checkpoint 被占（BUSY），WAL 未落主库——-wal/-shm 已一并拷贝"
88|                            .to_string(),
89|                    );
90|                } else {
91|                    return Err(CommandError::IoError(format!(
92|                        "老库校验失败，已拒绝拷贝以保护数据（原始老库未改动）：{e}。\
93|                         请先人工检查老库是否损坏，再重试或删除老库。"
94|                    )));
95|                }
96|            }
97|        },
98|        Err(e) => {
99|            // 源库打不开（损坏/被占用/加密）时继续裸拷 = 把坏库复制成主库。
100|            // 拒绝拷贝：原库只读未动，留给人工排障后重试。
101|            return Err(CommandError::IoError(format!(
102|                "老库打开失败，已拒绝拷贝以保护数据（原始老库未改动）：{e}。\
103|                 请关闭可能占用该库的程序（如旧版应用/数据库工具）后重启重试；\
104|                 若反复出现，请先人工检查老库是否损坏。"
105|            )));
106|        }
107|    }
108|
109|    // Phase 1: copy 3 files to staging tmp-*
110|    let legacy_wal = wal_sidecar(legacy_db, "wal");
111|    let legacy_shm = wal_sidecar(legacy_db, "shm");
112|    let tmp_main = db_path.with_extension("db.copying");
113|    let tmp_wal = wal_sidecar(&tmp_main, "wal");
114|    let tmp_shm = wal_sidecar(&tmp_main, "shm");
115|
116|    let copy_main = std::fs::copy(legacy_db, &tmp_main);
117|    let copy_wal = if legacy_wal.exists() {
118|        std::fs::copy(&legacy_wal, &tmp_wal)
119|    } else {
120|        Ok(0)
121|    };
122|    let copy_shm = if legacy_shm.exists() {
123|        std::fs::copy(&legacy_shm, &tmp_shm)
124|    } else {
125|        Ok(0)
126|    };
127|
128|    if let Some(e) = copy_main.err().or(copy_wal.err()).or(copy_shm.err()) {
129|        remove_staging(&tmp_main, &tmp_wal, &tmp_shm);
130|        return Err(CommandError::IoError(format!("老库 staging 拷贝失败：{e}")));
131|    }
132|
133|    // Phase 2a: rename tmp_wal → db_path-wal（仅当 tmp_wal 存在；legacy 无 -wal 则 skip）
134|    if tmp_wal.exists() {
135|        if let Err(e) = std::fs::rename(&tmp_wal, wal_sidecar(db_path, "wal")) {
136|            remove_staging(&tmp_main, &tmp_wal, &tmp_shm);
137|            return Err(CommandError::IoError(format!("老库 -wal 提交失败：{e}")));
138|        }
139|    }
140|
141|    // Phase 2b: rename tmp_shm → db_path-shm（仅当 tmp_shm 存在；legacy 无 -shm 则 skip）
142|    if tmp_shm.exists() {

145|            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(wal_sidecar(db_path, "wal"));

147|            return Err(CommandError::IoError(format!(
148|                "老库 -shm 提交失败（已回滚 -wal staging）：{e}"
149|            )));
150|        }
151|    }
152|
153|    // Phase 2c: rename tmp_main → db_path（最后，main commit 是 final）
154|    if let Err(e) = std::fs::rename(&tmp_main, db_path) {
155|        // 回滚 2a + 2b（db_path-wal / db_path-shm 已建）

161|        )));

22|/// 跑一轮评估，返回 MetricsReport

28|pub fn run(
29|    cfg: &EvolutionEvalConfig,
30|    db_path: Option<&Path>,
31|    applied_path: Option<&Path>,
32|    period: &str,
33|) -> Result<MetricsReport, String> {
34|    // 1. eval set

36|    // 2. applied（B4-1：路径推导修正）

40|    let live_keys: Vec<String> = if let Some(p) = db_path {

42|    } else {
43|        Vec::new()
44|    };
45|    // 4. feedback
46|    let feedback = read_feedback(&cfg.feedback_path)?;
47|    let (tool_total, tool_ok, hit_fractions) = aggregate_feedback(&cases, &feedback);
48|    // 5. compute
49|    let now_ms = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis();

51|        cases.len(),
52|        cases.len(), // B4-1 标注：无 case 级判定，恒 100% 占位（MetricsReport.case_passed_placeholder=true）；R2 接入 ChangeRecord 后实判

55|        &applied,
56|        &live_keys,
57|        &hit_fractions,
58|        now_ms,
59|        period,
60|    );

84|fn list_live_lesson_keys(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
85|    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 DB {db_path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
86|    let exists: i64 = conn
87|        .query_row(
88|            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mem_items'",
89|            [],
90|            |r| r.get(0),
91|        )
92|        .map_err(|e| format!("查 mem_items 表失败：{e}"))?;
93|    if exists == 0 {
94|        return Ok(Vec::new());
95|    }
96|    let mut stmt = conn
97|        .prepare("SELECT tags FROM mem_items WHERE kind='lesson'")
98|        .map_err(|e| format!("prepare mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
99|    let rows = stmt
100|        .query_map([], |r| {
101|            let tags: String = r.get(0)?;
102|            Ok(tags)
103|        })
104|        .map_err(|e| format!("query mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
105|    let mut keys = Vec::new();

108|        // tags 是逗号分隔；取第一段

111|            if first.starts_with("evo:") {

114|        }

119|/// 把 feedback 按 session / case 聚合
120|fn aggregate_feedback(
121|    cases: &[EvalCase],
122|    feedback: &[FeedbackEntry],
123|) -> (u64, u64, Vec<(String, f64)>) {
124|    // tool_calls: 全部 ToolError 信号视为失败调用，task_complete 视为成功调用
125|    let mut total: u64 = 0;
126|    let mut succeeded: u64 = 0;
127|    for f in feedback {
128|        match f.signal_type {
129|            SignalType::ToolError => {
130|                total += 1;
131|                // value 0.0/1.0 = 失败/不一定（按 0 算）
132|            }
133|            SignalType::TaskComplete => {
134|                total += 1;
135|                succeeded += 1;
136|            }
137|            SignalType::TaskFailed => {
138|                total += 1;
139|            }
140|            _ => {}
141|        }
142|    }
143|    // hit_fractions: 对每个 case 检查 feedback 里 thumbs_up / thumbs_down 比例
144|    let mut hit_fractions: Vec<(String, f64)> = Vec::new();
145|    for c in cases {
146|        let related: Vec<&FeedbackEntry> = feedback
147|            .iter()
148|            .filter(|f| {
149|                f.case_id.as_deref() == Some(c.case_id.as_str()) || f.session_id == c.case_id
150|            })
151|            .collect();
152|        if related.is_empty() {
153|            hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), 1.0));
154|            continue;
155|        }
156|        let pos = related
157|            .iter()
158|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsUp))
159|            .count() as f64;
160|        let neg = related
161|            .iter()
162|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsDown))
163|            .count() as f64;
164|        let frac = if pos + neg > 0.0 {
165|            pos / (pos + neg)
166|        } else {
167|            1.0
168|        };
169|        hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), frac));
170|    }
171|    (total, succeeded, hit_fractions)
172|}

1|//! EvalRunner —— 跑一轮评估、产出 MetricsReport
2|//!
3|//! 流程：
4|//!   1. 加载 eval_set.jsonl → EvalCase 列表
5|//!   2. 加载 evolution-applied.jsonl → AppliedRecord 列表
6|//!   3. 打开 dev DB（rusqlite 直连，无 AppHandle）→ 列出当前存活 lesson 的 mem_key
7|//!   4. 加载 feedback.jsonl → 计算 tool_calls_total / succeeded / hit_fractions
8|//!   5. compute() → MetricsReport
9|//!   6. 追加写 evolution-eval-results.jsonl + 打印到 stdout
10|//!
11|//! 不调 LLM；不动 prompt / TOOLS / 命令名 / 事件名 / JSON 字段 / 错误码。
12|

15|use rusqlite::Connection;

22|/// 跑一轮评估，返回 MetricsReport
23|///
24|/// `period` 标签："manual" / "before" / "after" / 自定义
25|/// `db_path`：dev SQLite 文件路径（None 时跳过 mem_items 状态读取，回滚率/存活期=0）
26|/// `applied_path`：B4-1 覆盖（CLI `--applied`）；None 按优先级推导
27|///（db 同目录 > eval_set 同目录兜底）
28|pub fn run(
29|    cfg: &EvolutionEvalConfig,
30|    db_path: Option<&Path>,
31|    applied_path: Option<&Path>,
32|    period: &str,
33|) -> Result<MetricsReport, String> {
34|    // 1. eval set
35|    let cases: Vec<EvalCase> = read_jsonl(&cfg.eval_set_path)?;
36|    // 2. applied（B4-1：路径推导修正）
37|    let applied_path = resolve_applied_path(cfg, db_path, applied_path);
38|    let applied = read_applied(&applied_path)?;
39|    // 3. live keys
40|    let live_keys: Vec<String> = if let Some(p) = db_path {
41|        list_live_lesson_keys(p)?
42|    } else {
43|        Vec::new()
44|    };
45|    // 4. feedback
46|    let feedback = read_feedback(&cfg.feedback_path)?;
47|    let (tool_total, tool_ok, hit_fractions) = aggregate_feedback(&cases, &feedback);
48|    // 5. compute
49|    let now_ms = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis();
50|    let report = compute(
51|        cases.len(),
52|        cases.len(), // B4-1 标注：无 case 级判定，恒 100% 占位（MetricsReport.case_passed_placeholder=true）；R2 接入 ChangeRecord 后实判
53|        tool_total,
54|        tool_ok,
55|        &applied,
56|        &live_keys,
57|        &hit_fractions,
58|        now_ms,
59|        period,
60|    );
61|    Ok(report)
62|}

64|/// 把 eval 结果追加到 evolution-eval-results.jsonl
65|pub fn append_result(path: &Path, report: &MetricsReport) -> Result<(), String> {
66|    use std::io::Write;
67|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
68|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
69|    }
70|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
71|        .create(true)
72|        .append(true)
73|        .open(path)
74|        .map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
75|    let line =
76|        serde_json::to_string(report).map_err(|e| format!("序列化 MetricsReport 失败：{e}"))?;
77|    writeln!(f, "{line}").map_err(|e| format!("写入 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
78|    Ok(())

81|/// 列出当前 mem_items 里 tags[0] 以 "evo:" 开头的 mem_key
82|///
83|/// 只读；缺表返回空 vec（dev DB 没建表时不 panic）
84|fn list_live_lesson_keys(db_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
85|    let conn = Connection::open(db_path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 DB {db_path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
86|    let exists: i64 = conn
87|        .query_row(
88|            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='mem_items'",
89|            [],
90|            |r| r.get(0),
91|        )
92|        .map_err(|e| format!("查 mem_items 表失败：{e}"))?;
93|    if exists == 0 {
94|        return Ok(Vec::new());
95|    }
96|    let mut stmt = conn
97|        .prepare("SELECT tags FROM mem_items WHERE kind='lesson'")
98|        .map_err(|e| format!("prepare mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
99|    let rows = stmt
100|        .query_map([], |r| {
101|            let tags: String = r.get(0)?;
102|            Ok(tags)
103|        })
104|        .map_err(|e| format!("query mem_items 失败：{e}"))?;
105|    let mut keys = Vec::new();
106|    for row in rows {
107|        let tags = row.map_err(|e| format!("read row 失败：{e}"))?;
108|        // tags 是逗号分隔；取第一段
109|        if let Some(first) = tags.split(',').next() {
110|            let first = first.trim();
111|            if first.starts_with("evo:") {
112|                keys.push(first.to_string());
113|            }
114|        }
115|    }
116|    Ok(keys)

119|/// 把 feedback 按 session / case 聚合
120|fn aggregate_feedback(
121|    cases: &[EvalCase],
122|    feedback: &[FeedbackEntry],
123|) -> (u64, u64, Vec<(String, f64)>) {
124|    // tool_calls: 全部 ToolError 信号视为失败调用，task_complete 视为成功调用
125|    let mut total: u64 = 0;
126|    let mut succeeded: u64 = 0;
127|    for f in feedback {
128|        match f.signal_type {
129|            SignalType::ToolError => {
130|                total += 1;
131|                // value 0.0/1.0 = 失败/不一定（按 0 算）
132|            }
133|            SignalType::TaskComplete => {
134|                total += 1;
135|                succeeded += 1;
136|            }
137|            SignalType::TaskFailed => {
138|                total += 1;
139|            }
140|            _ => {}
141|        }
142|    }
143|    // hit_fractions: 对每个 case 检查 feedback 里 thumbs_up / thumbs_down 比例
144|    let mut hit_fractions: Vec<(String, f64)> = Vec::new();
145|    for c in cases {
146|        let related: Vec<&FeedbackEntry> = feedback
147|            .iter()
148|            .filter(|f| {
149|                f.case_id.as_deref() == Some(c.case_id.as_str()) || f.session_id == c.case_id
150|            })
151|            .collect();
152|        if related.is_empty() {
153|            hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), 1.0));
154|            continue;
155|        }
156|        let pos = related
157|            .iter()
158|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsUp))
159|            .count() as f64;
160|        let neg = related
161|            .iter()
162|            .filter(|f| matches!(f.signal_type, SignalType::ThumbsDown))
163|            .count() as f64;
164|        let frac = if pos + neg > 0.0 {
165|            pos / (pos + neg)
166|        } else {
167|            1.0
168|        };
169|        hit_fractions.push((c.case_id.clone(), frac));
170|    }
171|    (total, succeeded, hit_fractions)
172|}

175|// 优先级 = 显式 --applied > db_path 同目录（applied.jsonl 与 DB 同在 data_dir）
176|// > 此兜底；此前直接用本兜底会读到 `<eval_set>.applied.jsonl`（不存在 → 空

1|//! 五个核心指标计算（spec R1）
2|//!
3|//! 1. 任务成功率 task_success_rate = succeeded / total
4|//! 2. 工具调用效率 tool_call_efficiency = successful_tool_calls / total_tool_calls
5|//! 3. 行为偏差 behavior_deviation = 1 - fraction(预期行为命中)
6|//! 4. 回滚率 rollback_rate = rollbacks / applied
7|//! 5. 污染存活期 pollution_survival_days = avg(applied_at 未滑动的天数)
8|//!
9|//! 纯函数，不调 LLM；只读 evolution-applied.jsonl + mem_items 状态。
10|
11|use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
12|use std::collections::HashMap;

14|/// 指标计算结果（一轮评估输出）
15|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
16|pub struct MetricsReport {
17|    /// 评估 case 总数
18|    pub case_total: usize,
19|    /// 评估 case 成功数（基于 expected_behavior 命中）
20|    pub case_passed: usize,
21|    /// B4-1 标注：case_passed 恒等于 case_total（无 case 级判定，100% 占位）——
22|    /// 消费方据此把 task_success_rate 显示为「占位」而非真实指标；
23|    /// serde default 兼容旧结果 jsonl（缺字段按 false 读）
24|    #[serde(default)]
25|    pub case_passed_placeholder: bool,
26|    /// 任务成功率（0.0-1.0）
27|    pub task_success_rate: f64,
28|    /// 工具调用总次数（来自反馈 + applied 记录）
29|    pub tool_calls_total: u64,
30|    pub tool_calls_succeeded: u64,
31|    /// 工具调用效率
32|    pub tool_call_efficiency: f64,
33|    /// 行为偏差（0.0-1.0；越大越偏离）
34|    pub behavior_deviation: f64,
35|    /// 已应用提案数
36|    pub applied_total: u64,
37|    /// 回滚数
38|    pub rolled_back_total: u64,
39|    /// 回滚率
40|    pub rollback_rate: f64,
41|    /// 当前仍存活的 lesson 数（污染存活）

43|    /// 污染存活期（天；仅对当前存活 lesson 求均值）
44|    pub pollution_survival_days: f64,
45|    /// 评估时刻（epoch ms）
46|    pub evaluated_at_ms: i64,

53|pub struct AppliedRecord {
